name: Gakkou Nanafushigi ~Shougakkou no Hanako-san~
original_name: 学校七不思議～小学校の花子さん～
source:
Do you know "Hanako" ? It's a monster living in girls' toilet of the elementary school. But there are rumors that Hanako has been captured by a real demon. Is there a way to help Hanako and defeat the demon?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你知道“花子”吗？这是住在小学女生厕所里的怪物。但有传言说花子被真正的恶魔抓走了。有没有办法帮助花子打败恶魔呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
